title: 上海交大教授：AI公司上市，市场是否低估风险？
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: And this dovetails with what the CSRC chair talked about with the liberalizing of the rules to list these less profitable AI firms.
segments.zh: 这与证监会主席提到的放宽规则、允许盈利较低的AI公司上市相吻合。

segments.en: And we did see a surge in IPO after that, but do you think the market is maybe underpricing the risk given the lack of visibility around profits?
segments.zh: 此后IPO激增，但鉴于盈利前景不明，市场是否低估了风险？

segments.en: Well, I think we are living through a period of fairly available liquidity all over the world. So I think this is not just a China phenomenon.
segments.zh: 我认为我们正经历全球流动性相当充裕的时期，这并非中国独有的现象。

segments.en: This is probably as prevalent as it is in the NASDAQ and the US market. So I think we're going through a period of time where people have very high hope for AI and related innovation and also at the same time people are willing to pay the risk for the potential fluctuations in the market eventually.
segments.zh: 这与纳斯达克和美国市场一样普遍。当前人们对AI及相关创新抱有很高期望，同时愿意为市场潜在波动承担风险。

segments.en: So I think the jury is still out for whether we're making the right bet at the right moment.
segments.zh: 所以，我们是否在正确时机押对了注，尚无定论。
